title: When a relieving letter becomes leverage during notice period
description: Notice-period friction is often a process problem before it becomes a legal one. Keep the exit trail written, specific, and separate from emotional escalation.

The exit email that changes a week

A resignation sent after a difficult meeting can produce three different dates: the date the employee sent it, the date HR acknowledged it, and the proposed last working day. Keep them separate.
